rationale: PINS the zig systems-wave surface (2026-08-29): (1) calls to callee LEAFs (compute->perimeter, main->compute), (2) uses on field access (perimeter->sides), (3) contains for container ownership, (4) references via declared_type (Shape) AND via import (@import("std") with meta.isImport, family c-standard), (5) per-symbol complexity (compute=3: if+else), (6) parameters payload (s:*Shape), (7) pub visibility, and (8) struct/enum/error-set/EnumMember symbol kinds. These fixtures make the grammar audit (F1), relationship-kind (section B), payload matrix (section C), and evidence-tiers (section D) gates possible for zig — the analyzer emitted NONE of calls/uses/references/complexity before this wave. ZGD-wave addendum (M37 #600): ZGD1 forbids uses on assignment LHS (set/bump); ZGD2 pins bare-ident (Widget) + qualified (Writer) return-type declared-type refs; ZGD3 forbids test/comptime locals as symbols; ZGD4 pins the usingnamespace-wrapped import and forbids calls->usingnamespace; ZGD5b forbids uses from qualified type annotations. Z44 (wave 9, the final review): the complexity OPERATORS (for/while/switch/and/or/orelse, and accumulation across two constructs) were counted by the implementation and pinned by NOTHING. All eight values were hand-computed from the documented rule and matched on the first run — the implementation was right and the fixture was thin. Pinned now, so a regression in any of them is caught by F3 instead of discovered by a reader.

expectRelationships.note: Z66: the callee is `std.math.add`, a builtin reached through the name this file binds by @import, so the edge names the receiver instead of a bare `add` that a local `add` would also satisfy. meta.zigExternalRef/meta.zigImportAlias/meta.zigImportModule are pinned by zig/alias-receiver; the forbid row there pins the leaf.

expectRelationships.comment: Z15 (2026-09-28): `self.n += 1;` READS self.n before writing it — a compound assignment is a read-modify-write, and `while (i < n) : (i += 1)` is Zig's own idiom for it. The write gate tested the NODE and not the OPERATOR, so it suppressed the read of every compound assignment (280 compound field/index/deref assignments in the pinned corpora). The pre-fix state, which this row replaces, is now the FORBID above: `set -> n` is the only one of the pair that is a fabrication.

forbidRelationships.comment: ZGD1: `self.n = 5;` is a plain write — a write is not a read

forbidRelationships.note: pre-Z66 spelling. `std.math.add(u32, 1, 2)` is a builtin call, not a call of a local `add`; a regression to the leaf would satisfy nothing else in this fixture that names this edge.
